e14.speaker: Priya Shah
e14.text: Drywall crew is four people today, two of us are at the other site until noon.

e18.speaker: Marco Ruiz
e18.text: Morning. We are framing the level two corridor walls today, should be done by noon.

e34.speaker: Jonas Meyer
e34.text: The truss lift is planned for the day after tomorrow at seven with the mobile crane. Crew of six, same as last week.

e41.speaker: Hannah Kowalski
e41.text: We finish the home runs in 2E tomorrow, then after the weekend we move to 3B for the rough electrical.

e44.speaker: Jonas Meyer
e44.text: Roof sheathing follows the truss lift and takes two days, same crew.

e02.speaker: Marco Ruiz
e02.text: Starting the 3B partitions tomorrow at seven, per A-201 rev B.

e06.speaker: Priya Shah
e06.text: Can we close the walls in 2A this morning?

e51.speaker: Priya Shah
e51.text: 2D, the plumbing inspector is coming at nine, so we wait on the walls there.

e53.speaker: Hannah Kowalski
e53.text: On the next working day we start rough electrical in 3B. The wire is cut to length from E-201 rev A.
